title: TariTalk Nodes
summary: Independent community map of voluntarily registered, manually reviewed Minotari mainnet full nodes, with approximate locations, sync status and a deployment guide. The November 4 review covered all 42 directory entries, the guide, privacy notes and original discussion; the directory is not a complete network map. The deployment-tool repository that returned 404 on November 2 is now public, with MIT-licensed v0.1.0 source released November 4. Its guide requires a clean Debian 12/13 or Ubuntu 24.04/26.04 VPS, AMD64/ARM64, root access and public IPv4. Optional wallet-query and gRPC exposure are described in the source. The retained November 2 recording shows the map and guide; no software was installed, node registered or query endpoint exposed. Base nodes are not miners or seed nodes; no rewards are implied.
cardSummary: Explore a community map of Tari full nodes and a guide to running your own.
